KEEP THIS IN YOUR FIELD NOTES

An open door isn’t
a haunted house.

An open port means a service is listening. It doesn’t, by itself, prove a vulnerability or a compromise.

Open

A service is accepting connections or packets.

Closed

The port responds, but no application is listening.

Filtered

Nmap cannot tell whether it’s open or closed.

Read all six states in Nmap’s official guide ↗
